title: Kirby Problem 3.69
exact_target: Determine the integral homology-cobordism group, whether it has nontrivial torsion or torsion with Rokhlin invariant one, and its stated infinitely-many-divisors condition. The literal last condition is already satisfied by the zero class.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2867 (KP-3.69). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (editors), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295 (2026), Problem 3.69, p. 181 and following remarks; original author version.
